Digital decay (or bit rot) is the gradual, silent corruption of digital data stored on physical media. It happens when microscopic physical changes (such as degrading magnetic charges or rotting discs) cause individual binary 0s and 1s to flip. This leads to unreadable files, glitchy, distorted images, and pixels rearranged in random spots.  . . . #digitaldecay #corruption #tech #viral #fypp
